analysis_scope: Descriptive same-complete-state, same-one-action H8 diagnostics from control probes only; no external task efficacy or independent retention claims.

definitions.error_population: 324 nonzero registered candidates; duplicate actions retained; zero candidates included in 19-candidate rankings
definitions.paired_difference_sign: left method actual minus right method actual; lower costs are better
definitions.step_error_population: same 324 nonzero candidate actions at every step, current/old losses separately; step0 included as zero-error boundary

execution_resources.scope: Runner and recorded per-plan/branch measurements; excludes earlier encoder preparation and later independent evaluation. Recovery child CPU is not measured.

interpretation_notes: Eighteen anchors are repeated local states on six seed/Head trajectories, not eighteen independent tasks; no anchor bootstrap or significance test is performed.
Candidate oracle is a hindsight minimum over this frozen executed candidate pool, not an online policy, a continuous-action oracle, or evidence of general optimality.
Full and Loss2 predictions use each identical candidate action [u,0,...,0]. This separates same-action predictive error from differences in proposed action.

Loss2 results diagnose the present two-loss projection/closure implementation; they do not prove that every two-dimensional observation, history-aware summary, or learned filter is theoretically insufficient.

First-step maps/actions coincide while later map propagation diverges. Full carries the Adam parameter/moment tangent state; the present Loss2 closure projects that dynamics into two losses at each step.
Old probe constraints are slack, all hard multipliers zero, and hard actions equal soft actions. This experiment does not identify the benefit of active retention constraints.
No executed action reaches a coordinate box bound. Small intervention results do not establish the action capacity of larger masks or multi-Cell systems.
Common costs combine loss displacement, old hinge and charged effort. They are not external risk estimates and must not be confused with terminal current NLL alone.
Repeated hard/soft and H1 model actions create ties. Frozen tolerance/tie order is retained; exact distinct action counts and every pair classification are supplied.
Full tangent errors are local nonlinear/model approximation errors on these particular actions; a small error here does not certify nonlinear retention for arbitrary future actions.

hard_retention.interpretation: All registered probe trajectories, including zero intervention, satisfy retention. Hard constraints are inactive; hard/soft equality supplies no evidence that active constraints repair forgetting. Independent retention is not assessed here.
